notFound.title: That order is not here any more
notFound.text: You may have cancelled it, or the link is old. Open it again from your orders.

notChangeable.title: This order can no longer be changed
notChangeable.text: The cutoff has passed, or the stall has already moved the order on. To ask about it, contact the stall.

title: Edit order {{code}}

banner.title: After you save, the order goes back to Placed and {{stall}} approves it again.
banner.text: Your stock stays reserved while they review. You get a notification when it is accepted.

help: You can change quantities or remove items here until the cutoff. A line can go up by what {{stall}} still has for this pickup day. To add something else, place a new order.
